sloka: एते हि फुल्लनयनास्त्रासादागतसाध्वसाः ।कर्णे कर्णे प्रकथिता हरयो हरिसत्तम ।। ६.४६.४३ ।।।।
transliteration: ete hi phullanayanāstrāsādāgatasādhvasāḥ ।karṇe karṇe prakathitā harayo harisattama ।। 6.46.43 ।।।।

translations.english: "Let the army forces of monkeys be happy seeing me moving, getting rid of the inherent fear in them just as they discard a garland of flowers enjoyed by them earlier."
